AUTHOR CONTRIBUTIONS
Ariane Bouffard: conceptualization, data collection, analysis, visualization, and writing original draft. Marie Larocque: conceptualization, funding acquisition, and supervision. Mathieu Vaillancourt: data collection and analysis. Michelle Garneau: conceptualization. Monique Poulin: conceptualization and supervision. All authors contributed to manuscript review and editing.

Field data were collected in the Minganie and Basse-Côte-Nord, Quebec, Canada, peatlands in july 2022. These data support the article "Vegetation shifts in boreal ombrotrophic peatlands following road construction" by Bouffard et al. Submitted to Applied Vegetation Science DOI: XXX.
The dataset comprises vascular plant, bryophyte and lichen cover data collected from 541 plots distributed across 14 peatlands. It also includes contextual observations (peatland type, surficial deposit, road age, presence of watercourses, etc.) and environmental measurements (pH, electrical conductivity, water table depth, and peat thickness). Plot locations are provided as geographic coordinates in NAD83.
The complete R code used for statistical analyses and figure preparation is included.
This project was funded by the MTMD grant 4502-21-RF01 (project R856.1).
This research data is related to Ariane Bouffard's doctoral thesis (Environmental Sciences, UQAM).
